# Cash 4 Gold

> Johannesburg-based buyer and pawnbroker of gold, luxury watches, boats, cars and anything else of value. Instant, confidential payouts with free on-the-spot valuation and free collection across Gauteng, South Africa.

Cash 4 Gold buys and lends against valuable items from its premises at 20 6th Street, Delarey, Johannesburg, and offers free, discreet, insured collection across Johannesburg and greater Gauteng (including Johannesburg, Randburg, Sandton, Roodepoort, Soweto and Pretoria). Testing and weighing happen in front of the customer, offers are explained transparently (weight, purity, market rate), and payment is made the moment an offer is accepted — cash or instant EFT, same day. Pawned items are kept in secure, insured storage and returned in the condition they were left.

## Business facts

- Trading name: Cash 4 Gold
- Address: 20 6th Street, Delarey, Johannesburg, Gauteng, South Africa
- Phone: 010 023 6649
- WhatsApp: 072 792 9452 (fastest response)
- Email: info@cash-4-gold.co.za
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00 - 22:00
- Licensing: licensed gold buyer; SAPS-registered Second-Hand Goods dealer (Second-Hand Goods Act 6 of 2009)
- Pricing basis: gold rates are linked to the daily gold spot price and the USD/ZAR exchange rate; final offers are confirmed after on-the-spot testing and weighing in front of the customer
- Payment methods: cash or instant EFT
- Privacy: personal information is processed in accordance with POPIA (Protection of Personal Information Act 4 of 2013); the enquiry form opens WhatsApp with a customer-controlled, pre-filled message; no advertising trackers are used

## Services

### Cash for Gold (https://cash-4-gold.co.za/gold.html)

Buys all caratages from 9ct to 24ct: broken chains and bracelets, rings and wedding bands, earrings and pendants, Krugerrands and gold coins, dental gold, scrap and unmarked gold, and gold watches — hallmarked or not. Gold is tested (acid and electronic testing), weighed on a certified scale in front of the customer, and paid by weight and purity linked to the daily gold spot price and USD/ZAR rate. Customers may sell outright or pawn items and buy them back within an agreed period. No appointment is needed; free collection is available across Gauteng; payment is instant.

### Luxury Watches (https://cash-4-gold.co.za/watches.html)

Buys and pawns recognised Swiss and luxury watch brands: Rolex, Omega, Breitling, Cartier, TAG Heuer, Audemars Piguet, Panerai, Hublot, Tissot and other fine brands — with or without the original box and papers. Watches are authenticated and valued in front of the customer. Outright sale or pawn with secure storage; same-day payment by cash or instant EFT. Service is confidential and discreet.

### Boats & Jet Skis (https://cash-4-gold.co.za/boats.html)

Buys and pawns fishing vessels, speedboats, ski boats, cabin cruisers, jet skis and inflatables — with trailer and papers where available. Free, discreet collection across Gauteng; pawned craft are kept in secure, insured storage on the premises for the full loan period and returned in the condition they were left. Market-linked offers; same-day payment.

### Pawn Your Car (https://cash-4-gold.co.za/cars.html)

Lends against sedans, hatchbacks, SUVs and bakkies in good condition — with or without outstanding finance. A pawn-and-drive option lets customers keep driving the vehicle during the loan period; alternatively the vehicle is kept in secure, insured storage. No credit checks — the vehicle is the security. Loan amount, term, repayment total and end-of-term terms are documented in writing upfront; no hidden fees. Indicative offers via WhatsApp from make, model, year, mileage and finance status; payout in minutes by instant EFT or cash after inspection and signed documents. Free vehicle collection.

### Anything of Value (https://cash-4-gold.co.za/anything-of-value.html)

Buys and lends against anything with resale value: electronics (laptops, gaming consoles, drones, high-end smartphones, audio equipment), cameras and lenses (DSLR, mirrorless, vintage film), power tools, musical instruments (guitars, amps, keyboards, brass, DJ equipment), antiques and collectibles (silverware, coins, medals, rare books), and designer and luxury goods (handbags, sunglasses, pens, jewellery). Free valuation with no obligation; free collection across Gauteng; sell outright for instant cash or pawn with secure storage and buy back within the agreed term.

## Blog

### How We Test Your Gold (https://cash-4-gold.co.za/blog/how-we-test-your-gold.html)

Explains the four steps a Johannesburg gold buyer uses to verify an item before paying: hallmark inspection (375/585/750/916 stamps), the magnet test, acid testing for unmarked items, and weighing on a calibrated scale in front of the customer. Positions transparent testing as the standard customers should demand from any buyer.

### How Gold Prices Are Calculated (https://cash-4-gold.co.za/blog/how-gold-prices-are-calculated.html)

Explains the gold spot price (USD per troy ounce), the effect of the USD/ZAR exchange rate, karat purity fractions (9ct 37.5%, 14ct 58.5%, 18ct 75%, 22ct 91.6%, 24ct 99.9%), and the payout formula: gram rate = 24ct spot value x purity fraction; estimate = gram rate x weight. Notes that dealers apply a margin and lists red flags when comparing buyers. Links to the on-site gold calculator.

### Pawning vs Selling (https://cash-4-gold.co.za/blog/pawning-vs-selling.html)

Explains the difference between pawning (a loan secured by the item, held in secure storage until repaid, no credit bureau checks) and selling (final, unconditional cash, usually a better amount per item). Covers how to choose between them and how both are regulated in South Africa under the Second-Hand Goods Act (SAPS dealer registration and record-keeping) and the National Credit Act framework (written loan terms).

## How it works

1. Bring the item to 20 6th Street, Delarey (Mon-Fri 9:00-22:00), or book free, discreet collection anywhere in Gauteng.
2. Items are tested and weighed/assessed in front of the customer and a transparent, market-linked offer is made — no obligation.
3. Accept the offer and get paid in minutes by cash or instant EFT. Alternatively pawn the item: it is stored securely until the loan is repaid and the item is collected.

## Frequently asked questions

### What gold do you buy?

All caratages from 9ct to 24ct: broken chains, rings, earrings, coins, Krugerrands, dental gold, scrap gold and unwanted jewellery — hallmarked or not.

### How is gold priced?

The caratage is tested, the item is weighed in front of the customer, and payment is by weight and purity, linked to the daily gold spot price and the USD/ZAR exchange rate. Indicative per-gram rates are shown on the website; final offers are confirmed after on-the-spot testing and weighing.

### Can items be pawned instead of sold?

Yes. Items can be pawned for an instant loan and bought back within the agreed period. Pawned items are kept in secure, insured storage and returned in the condition they were left.

### Do you buy watches without box and papers?

Yes. Watches are bought and pawned with or without the original box and papers; authentication happens on the spot.

### Which vehicles do you accept for pawning?

Sedans, hatchbacks, SUVs and bakkies in good condition — with or without outstanding finance.

### What is the pawn-and-drive option?

An option that lets the customer keep driving their vehicle during the loan period. Terms are agreed in writing upfront.

### Do you run credit checks on car pawns?

No credit checks — the vehicle is the security for the loan.

### Do you collect items?

Yes — free, discreet, insured collection across Johannesburg and greater Gauteng.

### How fast is payment?

Instantly. Once an offer is accepted (and documents are signed, for vehicles), payment is made by cash or instant EFT in minutes, same day.

### Is the service confidential?

Yes. Valuations are conducted privately and discreetly, and transactions are never shared.
